blind_card.visible_setting: A dry apartment corridor seen entirely from outside one dominant fully closed warm-brown wooden apartment door. Two hinges are visible on the left edge. One waist-height exterior lever sits only 7 to 10 centimetres from the opposite right latch edge. A small cropped elevator at far left is visibly mid-close: its metal leaves cover about 80 percent and leave a black vertical opening 15 to 20 percent of the lift width.
blind_card.observable_action: The man stands immediately right of the jamb in strict left-facing side profile. His anatomical left shoulder, elbow, forearm, wrist, and hand form one continuous visible line to the right-edge lever. The woman alone has a floor path that runs outward from the apartment door toward the lift, makes a tight U-turn beside its remaining opening, then returns to her raised heel as her right palm forcefully pushes the same door's center-left wood.
blind_card.hands_and_contact: Exactly two hands are visible. The man's anatomical left hand depresses the latch-side lever. The woman's right palm presses uninterrupted brown wood with grain around every finger. Her left hand and his right hand are completely occluded. The rolled umbrella clips to her tote without a hand. No person touches the other.
blind_card.gaze: Each person looks at their own door contact, not at one another or the viewer.
blind_card.body_blocking: The man stays outside the right jamb in side profile while the woman stands before the center-left wood panel. Clear air separates their torsos and limbs.
blind_card.object_state: The apartment door is fully closed and physically coherent. The elevator is visibly mid-close rather than shut. The floor path visibly U-turns from the lift back to the apartment door. No key, fob, control plate, extra person, reflection, vehicle, or helmet appears.
blind_card.camera_view: A medium-wide straight-on full-body view shows the entire door slab, left hinges, right latch edge, short-backset lever, both separate contacts, body gap, mid-closing far-left elevator, and U-turn floor path.
blind_card.visible_continuity: Dry clothes, tote, hands-free rolled umbrella, visibly closing lift, and the outward-then-U-turn-return floor path make this a before-departure callback rather than an arrival.

director_slide.critic_evidence: Left hinges oppose a short-backset right-edge lever. A 15 to 20 percent lift opening and U-turn floor path show the woman returned. The man's strict left profile attributes the lever to his anatomical left hand; both spare hands are fully occluded.
